stories.title: Broken-down train at Gwersyllt disrupts Wrexham to Bidston services
stories.summary: Rail passengers on the Wrexham to Bidston line face delays and cancellations this morning after a train broke down at Gwersyllt. Transport for Wales said services may be delayed by up to 60 minutes and could be cancelled in both directions between Wrexham Central and Bidston. stories.title: Council steps in to bridge joint archive’s £1.2m shortfall
